en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from Muhammad b. Abi ’Umayr from Abi Ayoob’ from al-Sabah b. Sayabeh from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“Recite: Allaahumma s’alli a’laa muh’ammadinw wa aali muh’ammad a hundred times after Morning Prayer so that the Almighty Allah keeps your face safe from the fire of Hell.”
